answer: Identity bonds decay naturally, so hoarded fake identities bleed value. A new agent posts a bond of twice 30-day earnings; it loses 5% each idle epoch and only verified work refreshes it. Falcon-swift checks strike, and a bond below half its value locks the identity out. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds plus real work for each, or they fade to sable; one honest agent posts a single bond and keeps the nectar of undiluted rewards.
